findings.name: Dynamic plugin loaded via dlopen without signature verification
findings.description: dynamic_plugin_adapter.c:84-92: dlsym loads plugin functions without signature/hash verification of the .so file
findings.recommendation: Verify plugin ELF signature before loading

findings.name: No audit trail for credential CRUD operations
findings.description: identity_service.c: CRUD operations perform DB writes without emitting security audit events
findings.recommendation: Add security audit events for credential lifecycle

findings.name: No transport-layer encryption for handshake metadata
findings.description: soft_bus_channel.c: Protocol data transmitted through SoftBus without additional transport encryption; metadata observable
findings.recommendation: Consider padding or transport wrapper for metadata

findings.name: Credential DB file paths constructed from static format strings
findings.description: credential_data_manager.c:164: Hardcoded path template makes credential data location predictable on filesystem
findings.recommendation: Consider path randomization or alternative naming

findings.name: No rate limiting for PIN-based authentication attempts
findings.description: device_auth.c:299: PIN-based auth path lacks rate limiting or attempt counting; repeated attempts possible
findings.recommendation: Implement exponential backoff and max attempt limit

findings.name: Session timeout not enforced — stale sessions accumulate
findings.description: dev_session_v2.c: Session state machine transitions only on protocol events; no time-based expiration
findings.recommendation: Add configurable session TTL with background cleanup
